source_text: Sihon elatus et arbor infructuosa congressu cum Israel victus est. Cecidit gladio — gladio spiritus quod est verbum Dei. Diabolus spiritalis Seon hoc gladio prosternitur.
pass_a_gloss: Sihon exalted and tree unfruitful by-meeting with Israel conquered was. Fell by-sword — by-sword of-spirit which is word of-God. Devil spiritual Sihon by-this sword is-laid-low.
pass_b_english: [[Sihon >> Bible:Numbers 21:21-24]], proud and a barren tree, falls in battle with Israel — by the sword, that is [[the sword of the Spirit, the word of God >> Bible:Ephesians 6:17]]. The spiritual Sihon, the devil, is laid low by that sword.
